stories.headline: Katy Perry Erupts on Trump Administration for Using 'Firework' in Military Video - TMZ
stories.summary: Katy Perry just exploded on President Trump's administration for using her hit 2010 song, "Firework," in a social media video that shows missile attacks by the U.S. government.
stories.why: A major artist is publicly challenging the government's use of her work to glorify military violence—a rare moment where celebrity IP ownership intersects with real political power, forcing you to think about what your favorite songs actually represent.

stories.headline: Saturday Pre-orders – Aeldari Exodites in Kill Team - Warhammer Community
stories.summary: Check out all of this week’s pre-orders.
stories.why: Warhammer 40K's niche-to-mainstream pipeline keeps accelerating; if you're not collecting yet, your gaming friends probably are, and this faction drop signals where competitive play is heading.

stories.headline: Kalshi demands Netflix take down trailer for ‘Prediction Games’ documentary - TechCrunch
stories.summary: Kalshi claims the trailer is “defamatory” and contains “both fabricated documents and false and misleading statements.”
stories.why: A betting prediction platform is suing Netflix over a documentary that apparently threatens its credibility—this is the cultural moment where unregulated fintech gambling becomes mainstream enough to fight back against media scrutiny.

stories.headline: ‘The Odyssey’s $84M+ Second Weekend Will Be A Record For Christopher Nolan, Besting ‘Dark Knight’ – Saturday Box Office Update - Deadline
stories.summary: 'The Odyssey' second weekend of $84M+ is a record for Christopher Nolan, besting 'Dark Knight'
stories.why: Nolan's $84M second weekend proves audiences will show up for three-hour spectacle without superhero IP or franchise comfort food, redefining what 'event cinema' means post-streaming era.

stories.headline: Emma Roberts Marrying Fiancé Cody John This Weekend in Idaho - TMZ
stories.summary: Emma Roberts has a big weekend ahead ... 'cause TMZ has learned the actress is set to marry her fiancé, Cody John, in an intimate ceremony in Idaho.
stories.why: A Gen-Z celebrity (Julia Roberts' niece) choosing an intimate, private wedding signals a major culture shift away from Instagram-ready celebrity theater that you're probably noticing in your own social circles.

stories.headline: Courtney Shah Dead: ‘Jeopardy!’ Fans Mourn 7-Time Winner - TV Insider
stories.summary: The game show champ was also a history professor, and she was ‘wonderful in both roles,’ according to a former student and ‘Jeopardy! fan.
stories.why: A Jeopardy! champion's death matters because the show represents intellectual achievement that feels increasingly rare and aspirational—her dual role as scholar and TV personality embodied something most high-performing men respect.

stories.headline: San Diego Comic-Con 2026: The cosplay, in photos - Yahoo
stories.summary: See the best cosplay from San Diego Comic-Con 2026, from anime and manga hits to "Star Wars" and "Avatar," in photos from the convention floor.
stories.why: Comic-Con's cosplay evolution shows how anime/manga fandom has completely supplanted Western comic dominance in nerd culture; if you're still sleeping on anime, this is your signal the mainstream has already moved on.

stories.headline: Pamela Anderson Shines in ‘Rosebush Pruning,’ the Year’s Most Twisted Movie: ‘I Like Stirring It Up’ - Variety
stories.summary: Pamela Anderson talks “Rosebush Pruning,” a film about an incestuous family that’s a satire of fascism, and if she ever got that Seth Rogen apology.
stories.why: Pamela Anderson's career renaissance through serious art-house cinema (not nostalgia casting) proves the 90s icon box you thought was permanent can be shattered—relevant if you're reassessing what 'reinvention' looks like at 45+.

moments.author: Katy Perry
moments.quote: I am deeply appalled and angry to see “Firework” used on the @WhiteHouse TikTok account as a backing track for video footage of military strikes. I did not approve this, I was not asked, and I absolutely do not condone it.
moments.why: Her vehement condemnation of the White House’s unauthorized use of her song in a militaristic video struck a nerve for its strong stance on artistic integrity and politics.

moments.author: Marshall Cohen
moments.quote: UPDATE: I spoke to Kalshi and they said they want @netflix to take down this trailer because it’s "misleading." They also said they looked into one of the featured trades (at 0:29) and determined that it was placed in 2025, before the court order in Nevada.
moments.why: As a respected journalist, his update spotlighted the legal complexities around the documentary’s content, prompting widespread debate about journalistic vs. legal accuracy in streaming media.

moments.author: Reddit user
moments.quote: It was sold out before the preorder ever launched. The exodite kill team didn’t show up in the “preorders” section like normal... sold out in around 5 minutes so if you didn’t iron out all the kinks in that time you were out of luck.
moments.why: This frustrated reaction captured the chaotic frenzy around the Kill Team: Exodite preorder and resonated strongly among fans struggling to secure the in-demand boxed set.
